name: P4 Cockpit
summary: Touch instrument panel for Signal K, on a Waveshare ESP32-P4 display
description: A configurable instrument panel: gauges, arcs, anchor watch and digital switching, laid out in the Signal K HMI designer and rendered on the panel. Also does voice control and NMEA 2000 over CAN.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B (1024x600)
boards.notes: 1024x600 landscape, EK79007 controller. The 7B and the X are different boards: the wrong firmware leaves the screen black, because each drives a backlight pin the other does not connect.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-X, 7 inch (720x1280, rotated)
boards.notes: 720x1280 portrait ILI9881C on a 7-inch panel, shown rotated to landscape by the P4 PPA. Each size in the X series uses a different display controller, so a build is specific to one: the 8-inch and 10.1-inch X panels are JD9365 and are not supported. Not interchangeable with the 7B either — see that board's note.
